validity.recommendation: Human de-dup review of the whole UBTG-1 km-post cluster (P1898, P1899, P1900, P1901, P1910, P1911, P1912): confirm which are distinct physical lines vs GIS km-post segments of one Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas trunk before keeping P1901 as a standalone 204 km pipeline.
validity.researcher_notes: P1901 'UBTG-1km-Juanymah' is not an independently named pipeline; it is a kilometer-post GIS/engineering segment label. 'UBTG' = Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas, a real Aramco Master Gas System trunk that links the Uthmaniyah and Berri gas plants to the Juaymah NGL/gas complex on the Gulf coast (confirmed independently: MEED Master Gas System, Aramco elements magazine, and the Shammas 'Saudi Arabia Petroleum Industry Review' which names a 152 km UBTG-3 line linking Uthmaniyah to Juaymah and Berri). GEM has split this single km-posted trunk into a whole family of same-day (all updated 2022-07-19), endpoint-less, capacity-less rows sharing the 'UBTG-1' / km-post naming: P1898 UBTG-1-Berri (249 km), P1899 UBTG-1-Berri 2 (247 km), P1900 UBTG-km56-AY-1 KP916 (244 km), P1910/P1911 UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56 (56 km x2), P1912 Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0 (56 km). P1901 (UBTG-1 segment 'to Juaymah', 204 km) is very likely another km-post slice of this same physical UBTG-1 corridor rather than a seventh distinct pipeline; the cluster is prone to segment double-counting. This needs a human de-dup pass over the whole UBTG-1 family, not a per-row confirm. Independent sources corroborate the corridor/system but none names 'UBTG-1km-Juanymah' or the 204 km segment.

validity.recommendation: Treat length (204 km) and diameter (28,30,38,40 in) as unverified; do not present as sourced. Only citation is generic OPEC ASB which does not name this line and carries no per-pipeline km/diameter inventory. Owner/operator Saudi Aramco 100% is correct; gas transmission classification is correct.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/SPEC: the gem.wiki page's only two references are OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2012 p.75 and ASB2013 p.79 (footnote [2] carries the diameter). OPEC ASB is macro-statistics (reserves, production, exports, refining) and contains no named per-pipeline km/diameter inventory, so these citations do NOT name or support 'UBTG-1km-Juanymah', its 204 km length, or its 28/30/38/40 in diameters. No independent source corroborates the length or diameter (GulfPub's fuzzy auto-match to 'Jafurah Gas Plant [Condesate]' is a false positive on the word 'Juaymah' — Jafurah is a separate proposed condensate line to the Juaymah NGL Terminal, not this operating UBTG trunk segment; there is no real GulfPub counterpart for P1901). CLASSIFICATION is correct: UBTG is a gas transmission trunk, not gathering/process/oil/NGL. ATTRIBUTION is correct: Aramco owns and operates the Master Gas System 100% (parent Saudi Government). Capacity, StartYear, FuelSource are blank and could not be verified. Net: real corridor, correct commodity/operator, but the entity as a discrete 204 km named line and its specs are uncorroborated and rest on a non-naming generic citation.

fills.researcher_notes: Province was blank. The entire UBTG/Master Gas System Uthmaniyah-Berri-Juaymah trunk and the Juaymah terminus are in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province (MEED confirms the MGS/Uthmaniyah trunk; Power Technology confirms Juaymah is in the Eastern Province). Filling Start and End State/Province = Eastern Province. Capacity, StartYear, and FuelSource left blank — no verifiable value found; not forcing weak numbers on a row already flagged as a likely km-post duplicate.

routes.start_name: Uthmaniyah Gas Plant (approximate UBTG-1 origin; exact km-post start unconfirmed)
routes.end_name: Juaymah NGL / gas complex, Gulf coast near Ras Tanura
routes.corridor_desc: The UBTG (Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas) corridor runs north/NNE across Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province from the Uthmaniyah/Shedgum gas-plant area (northern Ghawar) toward the Berri gas plant and the Juaymah NGL terminus on the Persian Gulf coast just south of Ras Tanura. P1901 is the 'to Juaymah' segment; ~204 km straight-line Uthmaniyah->Juaymah (~200 km) is consistent with the stated length. Bound is LOOSE: sheet has no endpoints, no independent source gives this segment's exact start km-post or trace, and it may share track with sibling UBTG-1 rows. End (Juaymah) coordinates are a defensible approximation of a well-known named facility; start (Uthmaniyah) is a plausible-but-unconfirmed anchor for the UBTG-1 origin.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from the UBTG=Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas system definition (Uthmaniyah/Berri plants to Juaymah) corroborated by MEED (MGS/Uthmaniyah) and the Shammas review (UBTG-3 Uthmaniyah->Juaymah/Berri), plus DMS Universe and Power Technology placing the Juaymah NGL/cogeneration complex on the Eastern-Province Gulf coast. Coordinates are approximate real-facility positions (Uthmaniyah gas plant ~25.13N 49.17E; Juaymah ~26.88N 49.95E), not fabricated and not a surveyed trace — no intermediate waypoints sourced, so no waypoint coordinates invented. Suggested accuracy low: corridor and endpoints are defensible but the exact UBTG-1 km-post start and the on-ground route are unconfirmed.

summary: P1901 UBTG-1km-Juanymah: concern (duplicate + spec) — km-post GIS segment of the real Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas trunk, likely double-counted across the UBTG-1 family (P1898/1899/1900/1910/1911/1912); only citation is non-naming generic OPEC ASB so 204 km / 28,30,38,40 in are uncorroborated; operator/commodity correct. Route: Uthmaniyah->Juaymah, Eastern Province, suggested accuracy low.
